symptom: CE repair 1 fixed the entrypoint, but repair 2 regressed it and exhausted semantic repair while delivery depth remained infeasible.

dynamic_evidence.repair_1_effect: entrypoint changed from help introspection to an encrypt proof-of-work command
dynamic_evidence.repair_2_effect: entrypoint changed back to --help; no artifact_upsert authority was available

root_cause: The Factory CE multi-repair loop updates repaired_output_errors after composing repair 1, but only rebuilds semantic_repair_candidate and semantic_repair_diagnosis when the candidate is None. Repair 2 therefore receives current failure text combined with stale candidate and diagnosis CAS authority.

live_verification.result: CE completed and Factory advanced through Director into workspace quality validation
live_verification.independent_later_blocker: workspace-quality target rotation used the global repair round after the diagnostic signature changed

required_invariants: Each semantic repair attempt uses the current composed candidate.
Each semantic repair attempt recomputes diagnosis and allowed operations from current validation errors.
Candidate and diagnosis hashes advance when the composed candidate or residual diagnosis changes.
A later repair preserves fields fixed by earlier repairs.
required_verification: Regression test for entrypoint repair followed by delivery-depth repair.
Ruff and mypy pass for changed modules.
Fresh isolated L3-24 Bench final requests show new candidate and diagnosis hashes on repair 2.
residual_risk: The CE transaction defect is closed. L3-24 exposed an independent Director workspace-quality target-rotation defect tracked separately as L3-24-R32-DIAGNOSTIC-SCOPED-TARGET-ROTATION.
